title: lepisanthes tetraphylla
intro: Lepisanthes tetraphylla, commonly known as the Four-Leaf Erythrina, is a species of flowering plant in the family Erythrophleaceae. It is a tree native to tropical Asia, known for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits. Studies have shown that Lepisanthes tetraphylla may possess health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which could contribute to the prevention and treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiproliferative effects.
